findings.description: The Lambda environment embeds an AWS access key ID and secret access key directly in Terraform. These credentials can be exposed through source control, Terraform state, and Lambda configuration access; the function should use its execution role rather than static credentials.
The function uses the end-of-life Node.js 12.x runtime, which no longer receives security patches and can expose the function to known runtime vulnerabilities.
